d:
Expedition Unknown takes Josh Gates into some of the world's most mysterious and challenging locations. From dark underground passages and unexplored caves to remote mountain regions, Josh follows clues, investigates ancient mysteries and ventures into places few dare to explore. With hidden secrets beneath the surface and dangers at every turn, how much will he uncover on these extraordinary expeditions?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 2, Episodes 14, 2, 6 and 17; Season 4, Episodes 7 and 10; and Season 3, Episodes 5 and 15, on Discovery Channel India.
